assessments.reasoning: Five contiguous parts of SPDX’s json/details/CC-BY-SA-3.0-IGO.json cover 76,183 bytes at the tagged commit. Part 1 has isDeprecatedLicenseId=false and the IGO and ShareAlike text. Part 3 has the exact licenseId and both citations. Capture SHA-256 d1373832d0edd436dc751d400ff94d6a775a19f7c0f816439552b422b2dbcf7c.

The GitHub API record in spdx/license-list-data identifies annotated tag object 76c9a79bb7d2bf851143b76b3935a4d7cbaa644b as v3.29.0. Its target is a commit, 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48, exactly the detail locator’s revision. The tag is unsigned.

As context, the English Creative Commons capture at the exact cited URL has the heading “Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 IGO” and the claimed revision 584d8f6ae7ccc578a21f6eb28441edda04f22ca676607ccabbee4c355342c0a2. Its head declares https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/igo/legalcode.en as canonical and links French and Arabic alternatives.

challenge.method: Compared the identifier, text and cited URL with the Attribution-only IGO variant, the linked deed and the declared legalcode.en canonical. Checked the release tag’s target type and SHA.
challenge.results: The identifier and cited path both retain ShareAlike and IGO. The SPDX text adds “Creative Commons” to the heading and repeats “ii.” for the third royalty item in section 3(c), where the publisher HTML uses an ordered list. Those differences limit text comparison without changing the exact URL citation.

limitations: The SPDX entry documents its own identifier and citation. Its generated text shares the publisher’s source lineage. Neither that text nor the localized canonical link establishes byte, translation or legal equivalence. The finding supplies no project license, reuse right or installation decision.
reasoning: The SPDX v3.29.0 generated detail lists CC-BY-SA-3.0-IGO. Both crossRef[0].url and seeAlso[0] equal https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/igo/legalcode. The publisher capture independently identifies what that URL presented. This meets the SCES §7 requirement to pin an external list assertion to its owning source and exact revision.
